964.name: Windborne Notes
964.description: Grant nearby allies regeneration when you use a warhorn skill. Heal allies when you grant them regeneration.

965.name: Spirited Arrival
965.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when swapping pets.

968.name: Zephyr's Speed
968.description: Cast Lesser Quickening Zephyr when you swap pets.

970.name: Honed Axes
970.description: You and your pet gain ferocity. Axe skills gain reduced recharge, and you gain additional ferocity while wielding an axe.

974.name: Loud Whistle
974.description: While your health is above the threshold, your pet deals increased strike damage. Your pet swap gains recharge reduction.

975.name: Wilting Strike
975.description:
Beast abilities inflict weakness on those struck.
This effect will only occur once on each target struck by an ability.

978.name: Wellspring
978.description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill. You and your pet gain healing power based on power.

986.name: Clarion Bond
986.description: Cast Lesser Call of the Wild when you swap pets.

996.name: Predator's Onslaught
996.description:
You and your pet deal increased strike damage to disabled, defiant, or movement-impaired foes.
Affected conditions are stun, taunt, daze, cripple, fear, immobilize, and chilled.

1000.name: Farsighted
1000.description: Ranger weapon skills deal increased strike damage. Damage is further increased for foes above the range threshold.

1001.name: Wolfsong
1001.description: Canine <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities apply vulnerability and reveal nearby enemies. You deal additional increased strike damage against vulnerable enemies.

1009.name: Alpha Focus
1009.description: Your opening strikes inflict cripple on your foes.

1010.name: Opening Strike
1010.description: You and your pet inflict vulnerability with your first strike when entering combat.

1011.name: Precise Strike
1011.description: Opening Strike has an increased chance to critically strike.

1014.name: Hunter's Gaze
1014.description: Gain might when you strike a foe based on their health percent.

1015.name: Remorseless
1015.description: Regain opening strike whenever you gain fury. Opening strike deals more damage.

1016.name: Fang and Claw
1016.description: Feline, avian, and drake pets gain increased precision and ferocity. <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant fury around the ranger.

1021.name: Stoneform
1021.description: Use Lesser Signet of Stone when you use an elite skill. Activating a <c=@abilitytype>Signet</c> grants might and fury.

1038.name: Nature's Vengeance
1038.description: <c=@abilitytype>Spirits</c> slam again when they finish shaking.

1047.name: Bestial Rage
1047.description: Gain might and fury when you disable a foe.

1054.name: Evasive Purity
1054.description: Dodging removes a condition from you. Heal yourself if you remove a condition this way.

1055.name: Rejuvenation
1055.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant regeneration around the ranger.

1056.name: Fortifying Bond
1056.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

1059.name: Lingering Magic
1059.description: You and your pet gain increased concentration. Regeneration you apply is more effective.

1060.name: Allies' Aid
1060.description: Cast "Search and Rescue!" when you begin reviving an ally. Moa pets grant barrier to nearby allies with their <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skill.

1062.name: Bountiful Hunter
1062.description: You deal increased strike damage for each boon affecting you. Your pet deals increased strike damage for each boon affecting it.

1064.name: Quick Draw
1064.description: When swapping weapons, gain quickness. The next ranger weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

1065.name: Pet's Prowess
1065.description: Your pet moves faster and deals more damage on critical hits.

1066.name: Go for the Throat
1066.description: When you strike an enemy with a <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> ability, cast Lesser "Sic 'Em!" on the enemy.

1067.name: Primal Reflexes
1067.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

1068.name: Hunter's Tactics
1068.description: You deal more damage and have an increased chance to critically strike while attacking from behind or the side or when striking a defiant foe.

1069.name: Sharpened Edges
1069.description: You and your pet have a chance to cause bleeding on critical hits.

1070.name: Moment of Clarity
1070.description:
Gain an attack of opportunity for you and your pet on interrupting a foe. Daze and stun durations that you inflict last longer.
This trait can only grant an attack of opportunity against enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1072.name: Natural Healing
1072.description: Your pet recovers health each interval.

1075.name: Trapper's Expertise
1075.description: Increase the duration of boons and conditions applied by <c=@abilitytype>traps</c>. Offensive <c=@abilitytype>traps</c> inflict cripple.

1080.name: Tail Wind
1080.description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

1083.name: Furious Grip
1083.description: Gain fury when swapping weapons in combat.

1086.name: Oakheart Salve
1086.description: Gain regeneration when you are inflicted with bleeding, poison, or burning. While you have regeneration, you take reduced strike damage.

1089.name: Rugged Growth
1089.description: You and your pet recover health while affected by protection.

1090.name: Companion's Defense
1090.description: You and your pet gain protection when you dodge roll.

1094.name: Carnivore
1094.description:
Steal health from enemies when you or your pet disable them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1098.name: Child of Earth
1098.description: Create muddy terrain when you use a healing skill.

1099.name: Arachnophobia
1099.description: Spider pet's Spit and devourer pet's Twin Darts additionally inflict torment. You and your pet gain expertise; spiders and devourers gain more.

1100.name: Empathic Bond
1100.description: Remove conditions when you swap pets.

1101.name: Ambidexterity
1101.description: Gain condition damage. Gain additional condition damage while wielding a torch, dagger, or mace. Torch and dagger skills recharge faster.

1606.name: Resounding Timbre
1606.description:
Commands copy boons from yourself to your pet.
Soulbeast: when merged, extend the duration of boons on yourself instead.

1697.name: Invigorating Bond
1697.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills heal allies around the ranger.

1698.name: Lead the Wind
1698.description: Your longbow and harpoon-gun skills pierce and recharge faster. Point-Blank Shot grants boons.

1699.name: Wilderness Knowledge
1699.description: <c=@abilitytype>Survival</c> skills grant fury and remove conditions.

1700.name: Strider's Strength
1700.description: You and your pet gain power. Gain additional power while wielding a sword. Successfully evading an attack grants might.

1701.name: Poison Master
1701.description: Upon using a <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> ability, your pet's next attack will inflict poison; your poison damage is increased.

1846.name: Hidden Barbs
1846.description: Bleeding you inflict is more dangerous.

1861.name: Go for the Eyes
1861.description: Nearby foes are blinded by <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities.

1862.name: Live Vicariously
1862.description: When you heal an ally, you are also healed.

1868.name: Druidic Clarity
1868.description: Becoming a celestial avatar removes conditions from you and nearby allies.

1874.name: Celestial Being
1874.description: Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Glyphs</c>. Become a celestial avatar once you gain enough astral force. Generate astral force by healing allies and damaging foes.

1888.name: Vicious Quarry
1888.description: Fury grants ferocity and additional increased critical strike chance. When struck while below the health threshold, gain fury.

1900.name: Pack Alpha
1900.description:
Your pet's attributes are improved and pet skills gain recharge reduction.
Improved attributes are power, condition damage, precision, toughness, and vitality.

1912.name: Light on your Feet
1912.description: Damage and condition duration are increased after dodging or using a ranger skill that evades. Short bow skills pierce and gain recharge reduction, and their attacks from behind, while flanking, or against defiant foes are improved.

1935.name: Blood Moon
1935.description: Inflict bleeding on enemies you immobilize or disable.

1945.name: Beastly Warden
1945.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities taunt nearby foes. Ursine and porcine pets deal increased damage and have increased health.

1988.name: Protective Ward
1988.description: Cast Lesser "Guard!" when you swap pets.

1992.name: Natural Mender
1992.description: Increase healing to other allies. Gain astral force each interval while not in celestial avatar form.

2001.name: Grace of the Land
2001.description: Grant boons to allies within the radius of your <c=@abilitytype>Celestial Avatar</c> skills.

2016.name: Verdant Etching
2016.description: <c=@abilitytype>Glyphs</c> heal nearby allies. While in celestial avatar form, grant protection instead.

2032.name: Survival Instincts
2032.description: Gain increased outgoing strike damage and reduced incoming strike damage. When above the health threshold, outgoing strike damage is further increased. When below the health threshold, incoming strike damage is further reduced.

2053.name: Celestial Shadow
2053.description: Grant superspeed and stealth to nearby allies when leaving celestial avatar form.

2055.name: Eclipse
2055.description: Your <c=@abilitytype>Celestial Avatar</c> skills are offensively augmented. Striking enemies grants additional astral force.

2056.name: Natural Balance
2056.description: Upon entering and leaving celestial avatar form, deal increased condition damage and increased condition duration for a brief period.

2057.name: Cultivated Synergy
2057.description: When you use a healing skill, heal around your pet and create a water field attached to them. When you combo a water field with a blast finisher, sprout a Lesser Seed of Life at the location.

2058.name: Lingering Light
2058.description:
While in Celestial Avatar form, your healing of others is significantly increased. Healing another player with a Celestial Avatar skill reduces the cooldown of Celestial Avatar.
Cooldown can only be reduced once per outgoing heal and will occur even if the affected player is at full health.

2071.name: Live Fast
2071.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> ability grants you offensive boons.

2072.name: Unstoppable Union
2072.description: Entering or exiting beast mode grants protection.

2085.name: Essence of Speed
2085.description: Gaining quickness increases the duration of other boons affecting you.

2119.name: Second Skin
2119.description: Conditions inflict less damage to you while you have protection.

2127.name: Twice as Vicious
2127.description: Disabling a foe increases your damage and condition damage for a short duration.

2128.name: Leader of the Pack
2128.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c> skills gain increased duration on you and grant their effects to nearby allies for a reduced duration.

2134.name: Fresh Reinforcement
2134.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

2143.name: Oppressive Superiority
2143.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes at a lower health percentage than you. Conditions you apply to foes at a lower health percentage than you last longer.

2151.name: Elevated Bond
2151.description:
Gain access to Stances. Survival in the desert has enhanced your connection to your pet, granting you the ability to meld with them by entering beastmode.
Traits that affect your pet may affect you differently while in beastmode.

2155.name: Eternal Bond
2155.description: Heal when you use a merged skill. You can swap pets while merged.

2156.name: Furious Strength
2156.description: You deal increased strike damage while you have fury.

2161.name: Predator's Cunning
2161.description: When you apply poison to a foe, steal some health from them.

2263.name: Enhancing Impact
2263.description:
Disabling a foe grants you boons based on your current state.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2268.name: Unleashed Power
2268.description: Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Cantrips</c> and <c=@abilitytype>Unleash</c>. While your pet is unleashed, its skills are replaced with larger area-of-effect skills. Once per interval, <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills become available for a short period of time after you unleash.

2269.name: Vow of the Untamed
2269.description: Your outgoing strike damage is increased while you are unleashed. You take reduced damage from strikes while your pet is unleashed.

2271.name: Let Loose
2271.description: <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills grant boons to nearby allies. Refresh Unleashed Power when you swap weapons.

2274.name: Ferocious Symbiosis
2274.description: You and your pet grant each other increased damage and movement speed when striking enemies. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, it refreshes the duration of all stacks.</c>

2277.name: Nature's Shield
2277.description: <c=@abilitytype>Cantrips</c> grant barrier to you and your pet.

2278.name: Corrupting Vines
2278.description: Rending Vines converts boons into conditions instead of removing them. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills remove boons from enemies. <c=@reminder>Cannot affect enemies more than once per skill.</c>

2283.name: Biorhythm
2283.description: When you or your pet unleash, gain biorythm every interval for a duration. When you reach the biorythm stack threshold, the next time you or your pet unleash, gain both bonuses from Vow of the Untamed.

2286.name: Natural Fortitude
2286.description: Gain vitality. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills siphon health if they hit. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first. <c=@reminder> Cannot siphon the same target more than once per skill.</c>

2287.name: Cleansing Unleash
2287.description: Remove conditions when you or your pet unleash.

2297.name: Debilitating Blows
2297.description:
Disabling a foe applies conditions to that foe based on your current state.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2301.name: Blinding Outburst
2301.description: Venomous Outburst deals more damage and applies blindness in addition to its other effects. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills deal more damage.

2336.name: Gale Force
2336.description: Wind Force grants stacking increased movement speed and damage. When you use Hawkeye, convert these into a stronger bonus for a duration.

2341.name: Jetstream
2341.description: Your base movement speed is increased. Hawkeye grants superspeed.

2359.name: Teachings of the Tengu
2359.description:
Mastery of tengu wind magic allows you to conjure the Cyclone Bow at will. Using arrow-consuming skills grants Wind Force. After you reach the Wind Force threshold, you are able to use Hawkeye. Gain access to Squalls.
Using Cyclone Bow skills consumes arrows. You generate arrows every interval.

2360.name: Wuthering Wind
2360.description: After using Bluster, your pet's next attack creates a damaging swell of wind around its target.

2363.name: Bird of Prey
2363.description: Strike damage is increased when you have swiftness or superspeed. Swiftness is more effective.

2370.name: Feel the Rush
2370.description: Movement skills grant you swiftness and endurance.

2372.name: Shrike
2372.description:
After a number of missile hits, release a volley of arrows at your target and gain an arrow.
Missiles from this trait do not count toward its next trigger.

2396.name: Thrill of the Catch
2396.description: Restore arrows when you or your pet disable an enemy.

2402.name: Joy of Movement
2402.description: <c=@abilitytype>Squalls</c> remove movement-impairing conditions and a damaging condition.

2408.name: Flock Together
2408.description: Feathered pets have increased strike damage and health. <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant quickness around the ranger.

2413.name: Perilous Skies
2413.description: Quarry's Peril is replaced by Pelt.

2425.name: Cloudburst
2425.description: Quarry's Peril and Supersonic Arrow reset the cooldown of Bluster. When you use Bluster or Hawkeye, grant boons to nearby allies.

12466.name: Ricochet
12466.description: Bounce your axe between multiple foes, gaining might for each enemy struck.

12468.name: Poison Volley
12468.description: Fire a spread of five poison arrows. Poison lasts longer if you are flanking or behind the target or if you strike a defiant foe.

12469.name: Barrage
12469.description: Barrage the target area with a hail of arrows that cripple.

12470.name: Crossfire
12470.description: Fire an arrow that inflicts bleeding on your target. Attacks are stronger from behind or from the side or against defiant foes.

12472.name: Crippling Thrust
12472.description: Chain. Stab your foe, crippling them for a short time.

12473.name: Precision Swipe
12473.description: Deliver a blow to your foe. Your pet gains might for each foe struck.

12475.name: Hilt Bash
12475.description: Daze your foe with a hilt bash. Stun them if you hit from behind or they are defiant, and refresh your Maul skill.

12476.name: Spike Trap
12476.description: Trap. Set a trap that bleeds and launches foes.

12477.name: Crippling Talon
12477.description: Throw a dagger to bleed and cripple your foe.

12478.name: Stalker's Strike
12478.description: Stab and poison your foe while evading attacks. This attack deals increased damage and poison against movement-impaired foes.

12480.name: Splitblade
12480.description: Throw a spread pattern of five whirling axes that bleeds foes.

12482.name: Serpent's Strike
12482.description: Leap to your target and cripple them. If your target is disabled, defiant, or movement impaired, immobilize them instead.

12483.name: Troll Unguent
12483.description: Survival. You and your pet regenerate health over time.

12488.name: Enduring Swing
12488.description: Slash at your foe. This attack restores endurance if it hits.

12489.name: Healing Spring
12489.description: Trap. Heals you and your pet. Place a trap that grants regeneration and cures conditions on allies.

12490.name: Winter's Bite
12490.description: Throw an axe to chill the area around your foe. Your pet's next attack inflicts weakness.

12491.name: Signet of the Wild
12491.description:
Signet Passive: Increases the ferocity of you and your pet. 
Signet Active: Tap into the land to root foes around you.

12492.name: Frost Trap
12492.description: Trap. Set a trap that chills foes.

12493.name: Storm Spirit
12493.description: Spirit. Summon a storm spirit at a target location and apply vulnerability to nearby enemies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

12494.name: Lightning Reflexes
12494.description: Survival. Evade back with a crack of lightning, dealing damage and gaining vigor.

12495.name: Stone Spirit
12495.description: Spirit. Summon a stone spirit at a target location and apply aegis to nearby allies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

12496.name: Viper's Nest
12496.description: Trap. Set a trap that pulses poison on foes when triggered.

12497.name: Frost Spirit
12497.description: Spirit. Summon a frost spirit at a target location and apply resistance to nearby allies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

12498.name: Sun Spirit
12498.description: Spirit. Summon a sun spirit at a target location and apply blindness to nearby enemies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

12499.name: Flame Trap
12499.description: Trap. Set a trap that burns foes.

12500.name: Signet of Stone
12500.description:
Signet Passive: Improves toughness for you and your pet. 
Signet Active: You and your pet take no damage from attacks. You and your pet are still susceptible to conditions and control effects.

12501.name: Muddy Terrain
12501.description: Survival. Use mud to cripple, slow, and immobilize foes.

12502.name: Signet of Renewal
12502.description:
Signet Passive: You and your pet recover health. 
Signet Active: Grant resistance and resolution to your pet; it pulls conditions from nearby allies to itself.

12504.name: Bonfire
12504.description: Set a fire around you, damaging and burning foes.

12507.name: Crippling Shot
12507.description: Fire an arrow that cripples your target. If you are flanking or behind your target or your target is defiant, immobilize them. Your pet's next three attacks inflict bleeding.

12508.name: Concussion Shot
12508.description: Daze your foe with an arrow. Stun them if you hit from behind or from the side or if your foe is defiant.

12509.name: Rapid Fire
12509.description: Fire multiple arrows at your foe.

12510.name: Long Range Shot
12510.description: Shoot your foe from long range. The farther the arrow flies, the more damage it does.

12511.name: Point-Blank Shot
12511.description: Push back your foe with a point-blank shot. The closer they are, the farther it pushes them back.

12516.name: "Strength of the Pack!"
12516.description: Command. Rampage with your pet, gaining stability, fury, and swiftness. You and your pet also grant might to each other when you attack.

12517.name: Quick Shot
12517.description: Fire a quick shot in an evasive retreat. Gain swiftness. This can be used while retreating.

12521.name: Swoop
12521.description: Run and leap at your foe, hitting them and nearby foes.

12522.name: Counterattack
12522.description: Block incoming attacks. If an attack is blocked, Counterattack Kick can be used.

12523.name: Counterattack Kick
12523.description: Kick your foe, knocking them backward.

12525.name: Maul
12525.description: Attack your foe with the force of a bear. Your pet gains an attack of opportunity.

12526.name: Splinter Shot
12526.description: Shoot a spear that splinters around your target, striking and bleeding multiple foes.

12527.name: Mercy Shot
12527.description: Fire a shot that strikes for more damage the less health your target has.

12528.name: Feeding Frenzy
12528.description: Drive piranhas into a feeding frenzy around your foe. Apply fury to your pet.

12529.name: Coral Shot
12529.description: Shoot a spear that collects sharp coral as it travels, causing more bleeding the farther it goes and cripples.

12530.name: Ink Blast
12530.description: Retreat backward, leaving a blinding trail in your wake.

12537.name: Sharpening Stone
12537.description: Survival. Bleed foes with your next few attacks.

12542.name: Signet of the Hunt
12542.description:
Signet Passive: Grants 25% increased movement speed to you and your pet.
Signet Active: Attacks from you and your pet become unblockable, and you both gain superspeed.

12550.name: Quickening Zephyr
12550.description: Survival. You and your pet gain quickness and superspeed.

12552.name: Man O' War
12552.description: Strike your foe multiple times, then deliver a final immobilizing attack.

12557.name: Surging Maw
12557.description: Dart at your foe, inflicting more bleeding based on the amount of time spent charging.

12561.name: Counterstrike
12561.description: Prepare to throw your spear while blocking. If you block, push back your attacker with a kick.

12569.name: Spirit of Nature
12569.description: Spirit. Summon a spirit at a target point and convert conditions on allies into boons. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

12573.name: Hunter's Shot
12573.description: Fire an arrow that grants you stealth when it hits an enemy. Your pet gains swiftness.

12580.name: Entangle
12580.description: Survival. Entangle foes around you with vines. Entangled foes bleed and are immobilized until the vines are destroyed.

12597.name: Solar Flare
12597.description: Your sun spirit slams the ground and releases the brilliance of the sun on nearby foes.

12598.name: Call Lightning
12598.description: Your storm spirit slams the ground and generates a powerful blast of electricity.

12599.name: Quake
12599.description: Your stone spirit slams the ground and creates an earthen blast that inhibits enemies.

12600.name: Cold Snap
12600.description: Your frost spirit slams the ground and creates a cold snap that cleanses conditions from nearby allies.

12601.name: Nature's Renewal
12601.description: Your spirit of nature slams the ground and creates a blast of vital energy that revives nearby downed allies.

12620.name: Hunter's Call
12620.description: Call hawks to swarm your foe.

12621.name: Call of the Wild
12621.description: Daze and weaken nearby enemies. Grant fury, might, and swiftness to yourself and nearby allies.

12631.name: "Protect Me!"
12631.description: Command. Gain protection and barrier while breaking allies out of stuns.

12632.name: "Guard!"
12632.description: Command. Order your pet to guard nearby allies; your pet takes damage on behalf of those allies. Gain might when your pet receives damage.

12633.name: "Sic 'Em!"
12633.description: Command. Your pet rushes at your foe, revealing them and dealing increased damage.

12635.name: Throw Torch
12635.description: Throw your torch and burn your foes in an area.

12638.name: Path of Scars
12638.description: Throw your axe so that it returns to you, striking foes each way.

12639.name: Whirling Defense
12639.description: Spin your axes around you to attack nearby foes.

12676.name: Twin Darts
12676.description: Fire two shots from your tail that bleed your enemy.

13938.name: Lesser Muddy Terrain
13938.description: Survival. Use mud to cripple, slow, and immobilize foes.

21773.name: Water Spirit
21773.description: Spirit. Summon a water spirit at a target location and heal yourself and your pet. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

21776.name: Aqua Surge
21776.description: Your water spirit slams the ground and creates a wave that heals nearby allies.

29449.name: Lesser Call of the Wild
29449.description: Weaken nearby enemies. Grant fury, might, and swiftness to yourself and nearby allies.

30123.name: "Search and Rescue!"
30123.description: Command. Your pet will seek out and revive a downed ally.

30238.name: Glyph of the Tides
30238.description: Glyph. Draw your enemies in or knock them away.

31322.name: Glyph of Alignment
31322.description: Glyph. Damage and impair foes, or heal and remove conditions from allies.

31407.name: Glyph of Rejuvenation
31407.description: Glyph. Greatly heal yourself and your pet, while healing nearby allies for a minor amount.

31496.name: Sublime Conversion
31496.description: Summon an energy barrier that causes enemy projectiles to heal upon impact. Allies that pass through the wall gain boons.

31535.name: Ancestral Grace
31535.description: Become a wisp of natural energy, traversing to the targeted location. When you reach the target, heal nearby allies and grant protection to your pet. Recharge is reduced if you heal another ally.

31582.name: Glyph of Burgeoning
31582.description: Glyph. Use nature energy to heal allies and gain astral force or grant allies barrier and endurance.

31677.name: Glyph of the Stars
31677.description: Glyph. Channel the power of the stars to prevent harm to your allies.

31700.name: Vine Surge
31700.description: Send forth vines that immobilize enemies and cleanse conditions from allies.

31710.name: Solar Beam
31710.description: Fire a concentrated beam of light at the target enemy or ally, damaging foes and healing allies struck by the beam.

31746.name: Glyph of Equality
31746.description: Glyph. Daze foes or break stun for allies.

31776.name: Lesser Seed of Life
31776.description: Celestial Avatar. Summon a seed that heals and cleanses nearby allies of conditions when it blossoms.

31869.name: Celestial Avatar
31869.description: Consume your accumulated astral force to become a celestial avatar.

31889.name: Astral Wisp
31889.description: Send a wisp to a target area. It will detonate upon reaching the area, attaching to allies. Allies attached with a wisp heal over time.

31914.name: "We Heal As One!"
31914.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

34309.name: "Search and Rescue!"
34309.description: Command.Your pet teleports a downed ally within range of you and begins reviving them. Grant regeneration to nearby allies.

40111.name: Narcotic Spores
40111.description: Spit a glob of confusing spores at a foe, inflicting confusion for a while at that location.

40255.name: Smoke Assault
40255.description: Conceal yourself and lash out at nearby foes. Gain might each time you damage a foe.

40301.name: Leading Swipe
40301.description: Rake your dagger across your foe, leaving them bleeding.

40498.name: Vulture Stance
40498.description:
Stance. While in this stance, striking a foe inflicts poison and grants you might.
This effect can occur once per interval.

40588.name: Primal Cry
40588.description: Beast. Tap into your primal essence and unleash a debilitating roar.

40625.name: Bite
40625.description: Bite your foe for severe damage.

40729.name: Worldly Impact
40729.description: Beast. Jump up and slam the ground beneath you, severely damaging nearby foes.

41206.name: Rain of Spikes
41206.description: Launch spikes at all nearby foes.

41406.name: Maul
41406.description: Maul your foes and make them bleed.

41461.name: Devourer Retreat
41461.description: Retreat by tunneling through the ground.

41537.name: Chomp
41537.description: Bite a foe and gain health.

41575.name: Tail Swipe
41575.description: Attack all surrounding foes with a tail swipe.

41800.name: Serpent Stab
41800.description: Slash across your foe, poisoning them.

41837.name: Dark Water
41837.description: Blind foes near your target with a dark cloud.

41908.name: Wing Buffet
41908.description: Launch your foe backward with mighty wing beats.

42042.name: Quickening Screech
42042.description: Grant swiftness to nearby allies and remove movement-impairing conditions from them.

42470.name: Lesser Signet of Stone
42470.description: Signet. You and your pet take no damage from attacks. You and your pet are still susceptible to conditions and control effects.

42797.name: Charging Bite
42797.description: Charge your foe, striking multiple times and inflicting bleeding.

42809.name: Worldly Impact
42809.description: Beast. Draw in and release a blast of your energy, dealing hefty damage to nearby foes.

42894.name: Brutal Charge
42894.description: Leap at your foe and knock them down.

42907.name: Takedown
42907.description: Cripple your target with a powerful strike.

43060.name: Defy Pain
43060.description: You receive no damage from incoming attacks. You remain susceptible to conditions and controlling effects.

43068.name: Tail Lash
43068.description: Push back a foe with your tail.

43136.name: Bite
43136.description: Bite your foe to recover health.

43186.name: Healing Cloud
43186.description: Release a cloud of mist to regenerate you and your allies.

43375.name: Prelude Lash
43375.description: Beast. Pull foes toward you and bind them briefly.

43536.name: Double Arc
43536.description: Rip your blade through your foe twice, inflicting heavy bleeding. Your pet's next two strikes inflict poison.

43548.name: Frenzied Attack
43548.description: Attack with a pecking frenzy and make your foe vulnerable.

43671.name: Poison Gas
43671.description: Spit a ball of venom that covers an area with a poisonous cloud.

43701.name: Photosynthesize
43701.description: Restore health, gain regeneration, and remove conditions.

43726.name: Crippling Leap
43726.description: Leap at your foe and cripple them.

43788.name: Call Lightning
43788.description: Calls lightning to a small area.

44097.name: Entangling Web
44097.description: Shoot a web, immobilizing your foe.

44240.name: Lesser Quickening Zephyr
44240.description: Survival. You and your pet gain quickness and superspeed.

44278.name: Deadly Delivery
44278.description: Strike deeply into your foe, inflicting multiple conditions.

44360.name: Fear
44360.description: Make your foe flee in fear.

44384.name: Crippling Anguish
44384.description: Launch a projectile that inflicts conditions.

44514.name: Maul
44514.description: Slash a foe multiple times and make them bleed.

44626.name: Spiritual Reprieve
44626.description: Beast. Restore health to your allies and grant them a reprieve from conditions.

44885.name: Chomp
44885.description: Chomp your foe to deal damage and heal yourself.

44948.name: Bear Stance
44948.description: Stance. Heal yourself and your pet. Lose conditions while in this stance, healing for each condition lost.

44991.name: Swoop
44991.description: Swoop at your foe, making them vulnerable.

45142.name: Griffon Stance
45142.description:
Stance. Evade and gain endurance. Your endurance recovery is greatly improved. You gain might and superspeed when you evade attacks.
Evasion bonuses can occur once per interval.

45426.name: Groundwork Gouge
45426.description: Swipe past your foe's defenses, exposing their vulnerability.

45479.name: Sharpen Spines
45479.description: The next several hits apply extra bleeding stacks.

45717.name: One Wolf Pack
45717.description:
Stance. Your successful attacks will trigger a second strike while in this stance.
This effect can occur once per interval.

45789.name: Dolyak Stance
45789.description: Stance. Enter a defensive stance and remove conditions that impede movement. Prevent application of such conditions while in this stance.

45797.name: Unflinching Fortitude
45797.description: Beast. Shrug off all movement-impairing conditions and become unflinching in the face of normal attacks.

45970.name: Moa Stance
45970.description: Stance. Gain boons. Increase the duration of boons you grant while in this stance.

46123.name: Instinctive Engage
46123.description: Leap forward and slash at your foe. Gain quickness if you successfully strike.

46386.name: Tail Lash
46386.description: Sweep your foes along the ground, crippling them.

46432.name: Brutal Charge
46432.description: Charge your foes and knock them down.

46629.name: Maul
46629.description: Attack your foe with the force of a bear. Your pet gains an attack of opportunity.

59554.name: Eternal Bond
59554.description:
Meld with your other pet. 
This counts as swapping pets.

63065.name: Vicious Pike
63065.description: Unleashed Ambush.Spin and strike foes repeatedly. The final attack creates a spore under targets it strikes.

63094.name: Enveloping Haze
63094.description:
Summon a swirling spore cloud around your pet, destroying projectiles and chilling disabled or defiant enemies.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

63129.name: Sundering Volley
63129.description: Unleashed Ambush. Throw multiple axes at nearby enemies, inflicting conditions.

63130.name: Nature's Binding
63130.description: Cantrip. Surround nearby foes with a cage of nature they cannot escape. Enemies that were not struck are unaffected by active cages.

63131.name: Unleashed Savage Shock Wave
63131.description:
Smash the ground, creating three shock waves that deal damage. Deal increased damage to disabled enemies, defiant enemies, and enemies with conditions.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

63147.name: Unleash Ranger
63147.description: Unleash the raw power of your primal bond with nature and your pet, enhancing your offensive power.

63157.name: Exploding Spores
63157.description: Cantrip. Create a ring of spores around yourself that explodes after a short duration. Enemies hit by all spores are knocked down.

63163.name: Forest's Fortification
63163.description: Cantrip. Surround yourself with elements of nature, gaining defensive boons and damage reduction. Striking an enemy while this fortification is active reduces the cooldown of this ability.

63195.name: Unnatural Traversal
63195.description: Cantrip. Teleport to your target, making nearby enemies vulnerable. If an enemy is struck, this skill's recharge is reduced.

63197.name: Unleashed Overbearing Smash
63197.description: Quickly strike the ground, blinding nearby enemies. If this strikes an enemy, follow up with a leaping strike that removes boons.

63208.name: Unleashed Thump
63208.description: Leap forward and slam the ground with your hammer, gaining boons for each target struck.

63209.name: Venomous Outburst
63209.description:
Your pet teleports to your target and lashes out, poisoning enemies and applying vulnerability to disabled or defiant enemies.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

63225.name: Multishot
63225.description: Unleashed Ambush. Fire arrows at your target and other enemies near your target. Striking an enemy reduces the recharge of other longbow skills.

63256.name: Mutate Conditions
63256.description: Cantrip. Convert all your conditions into vulnerability.

63258.name: Rending Vines
63258.description:
Your pet strikes nearby enemies with vines, removing boons. Disabled or defiant enemies are also slowed.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

63301.name: Jagged Fan
63301.description: Unleashed Ambush. Fire a piercing spread of harpoons that inflicts conditions on enemies.

63319.name: Perilous Gift
63319.description: Cantrip. While active, you take no damage from incoming attacks or conditions. When the cantrip ends, heal based on a percentage of your missing health.

63326.name: Toxic Shot
63326.description: Unleashed Ambush. Fire three arrows that explode on impact, inflicting poison on enemies in the area. Inflict additional conditions on enemies who are already poisoned.

63335.name: Unleashed Wild Swing
63335.description:
Strike nearby enemies, inflicting damage. Deals increased damage to disabled or defiant enemies.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

63336.name: Deft Strike
63336.description: Unleashed Ambush. Leap forward and strike the ground, creating a spore under each enemy struck.

63337.name: Heavy Smash
63337.description: Smash the ground and damage nearby foes.

63344.name: Unleash Pet
63344.description: Unleash your pet to draw on the raw power of its bond with nature, granting it new abilities.

63350.name: Savage Slash
63350.description: Unleashed Ambush. Attack in an area around you, creating a spore under each enemy struck.

63438.name: Relentless Whirl
63438.description: Unleashed Ambush. Spin and attack nearby foes, moving faster while channeling. Create a spore when striking an enemy for the first time.

64038.name: Dash
64038.description: Charge forward, leaving behind a trail of wind energy that detonates shortly afterward.

64699.name: Slam
64699.description: Leap and knock nearby foes back.

64882.name: Undead Plague
64882.description: Emit noxious fumes that poisons foes in the area. Poison duration is increased on disabled foes.

66258.name: Heavy Shot
66258.description: Shoot a jade missile at your target that dazes nearby enemies on impact.

67382.name: Phase Pounce
67382.description: Leap through a rift in the Mists, shadowstepping briefly to the target's location and inflicting damage and conditions.

69167.name: Wild Swing
69167.description: Strike nearby enemies, inflicting cripple. Gain barrier for each target struck. Barrier is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

69175.name: Solar Brilliance
69175.description: Unleashed Ambush. Enchant yourself with solar energy, healing nearby allies and damaging nearby enemies over time.

69183.name: Lesser "Guard!"
69183.description: Command. Order your pet to guard nearby allies; your pet takes damage on behalf of those allies. Gain might when your pet receives damage.

69203.name: Pounce
69203.description: Deliver a leaping strike that deals more damage to disabled, defiant, or movement-impaired foes. Gain vigor if an enemy is struck.

69212.name: Thump
69212.description: Leap forward and slam the ground with your hammer, knocking down nearby enemies.

69223.name: Neurotoxin Burst
69223.description: Unleashed Ambush. Shadowstep behind your target and unleash a burst of toxic spores.

69262.name: Overbearing Smash
69262.description: Quickly strike the ground, dazing nearby enemies. If this strikes an enemy, follow up with a leaping strike that dazes enemies again. If you strike an enemy that is using a skill, gain barrier.

69340.name: Savage Shock Wave
69340.description: Smash the ground, creating three expanding shock waves that apply conditions.

70889.name: Ley-Line Vortex
70889.description: Spin around, creating a vortex of ley-line energy around you that strikes and inflicts conditions on enemies.

71282.name: Lunge
71282.description: Lunge forward, crippling opponents in the path.

71499.name: Electrocute
71499.description: Zap enemies in the target area with electric beams.

71546.name: Spit Goop
71546.description: Spit goop toward your target, crippling enemies.

71841.name: Wild Strikes
71841.description: Repeatedly slam the ground, damaging nearby enemies. The final slam does increased damage, dazes enemies, and grants Nature's Strength.

71885.name: Cultivate
71885.description:
Swing an uppercut at your target, crippling them and granting vigor to nearby allies. Gain Nature's Strength if you hit an enemy. 
This skill cannot activate Force of Nature.

71903.name: Thistleguard
71903.description: Envelop yourself in thorns, striking nearby enemies and gaining stability for a brief duration. Gain additional bonuses and Nature's Strength if you strike an enemy.

71963.name: Oaken Cudgel
71963.description: Imbue your mace with verdant energy and then leap to your target. Stun enemies, grant nearby allies protection, and heal your pet. Gain Nature's Strength if you hit an enemy.

71999.name: Flourish
71999.description: Strike the earth, damaging nearby enemies and healing nearby allies. The ground flourishes in response, repeating stronger effects after a delay. Gain Nature's Strength if the initial strike hits an enemy.

72079.name: Rampant Growth
72079.description:
Unleashed Ambush. Strike the ground with your mace, creating a cascade of verdant growth that immobilizes targets struck and heals nearby allies. Gain Nature's Strength if you hit an enemy.
This skill cannot activate Force of Nature.

72369.name: Carnivore
72369.description: Steal health from a disabled foe.

72636.name: Tormenting Visions
72636.description: Send distressing thoughts to your enemy to torment them.

72851.name: Staring Void
72851.description: Blast demonic energy in front of you, inflicting conditions on enemies it hits.

72922.name: Drake's Swipe
72922.description: Chain. Swing your spear. If your enemy is far away, use Bee's Sting instead.

72928.name: Falcon's Stoop
72928.description: Fling your spear at your enemy, dealing heavy damage. Damage is increased against immobilized, disabled, or defiant foes.

72932.name: Ravager's Abandon
72932.description: Unleashed Ambush. Release a wave of corruption in front of you, damaging enemies and spawning spores under targets struck.

73008.name: Panther's Prowl
73008.description: Conceal yourself in the brush, gaining stealth. Gain Hunter's Prowess, allowing you to use a Stealth Attack even if revealed.

73020.name: Warclaw's Engage
73020.description: Leap to a target location, damaging nearby enemies. Deal more damage to foes below the health threshold.

73087.name: Cheetah's Strike
73087.description: Chain. Heave your spear, gaining swiftness if you strike an enemy. If your enemy is far away, use Bee's Sting instead.

73110.name: Mongoose's Frenzy
73110.description: Swipe at enemies in front of you, cleaving them.

73112.name: Wyvern's Lash
73112.description: Chain. Strike with your spear, crippling your foe. If your enemy is far away, use Bee's Sting instead.

73938.name: Bop
73938.description: Smack your foe to knock them down.

75771.name: Bumble
75771.description: Charge at your enemy, knocking them down.

75814.name: Stinging Sorrow
75814.description: Unleash a flurry of rage-filled jabs.

76619.name: Whirlwind
76619.description: Squall. Launch yourself forward with powerful gust of wind.

76664.name: Hawkeye
76664.description: Release a hail of arrows toward your target and enemies nearby them.

76722.name: Pelt
76722.description: Fire a volley of arrows into the air, damaging enemies when they land.

76757.name: Mistral
76757.description: Squall. Summon a current of chilling northern air. Projectiles that pass through the current become frozen, chilling and dealing additional damage to enemies.

76787.name: Summon Cyclone Bow
76787.description: Conjure a powerful bow of wind that consumes arrows and generates Wind Force.

76905.name: Wuthering Wind
76905.description: Damage nearby enemies with a gust of wind.

76979.name: Perfect Storm
76979.description: Squall. Release a massive tornado, launching enemies it strikes as it travels. When the tornado reaches its destination, it will persist for a period, dealing damage to enemies inside of it.

77211.name: Wind Shear
77211.description: Squall. Wind swells around you, knocking back nearby enemies and reflecting incoming projectiles.

77213.name: Dismiss Cyclone Bow
77213.description: Dispel your Cyclone Bow, losing all Wind Force.

77264.name: Piercing Gales
77264.description: Squall. Conjure a barrage of wind to cut through your target. Deal increased damage against vulnerable foes. The wind flies faster when you have swiftness or superspeed.

77271.name: Soothing Breeze
77271.description: Squall. Call upon a gentle wind to heal and grant superspeed to you and your pet.

78091.name: Leaping Lizard
78091.description: Leap through the air, crippling enemies upon landing.

79203.name: Saurian Might
79203.description: Smash the ground before you with primal strength.

79371.name: Lesser "Sic 'Em!"
79371.description: Command. Your pet rushes at your foe, dealing increased damage.

80031.name: Tail Whip
80031.description: Slam your foe with your tail.

80035.name: Jet
80035.description: Dash at your foe with a wave of water.
